points.description: States that the storage volume vs elevation relationship (storage–elevation curve) of the reservoir must be known.
States that the inflow hydrograph (inflow vs time) must be known.
States that the water surface elevation vs outflow relationship (elevation–discharge/outflow curve) must be known.
States that the initial values of storage (S), inflow (I) and outflow (Q) at t = 0 must be known, naming all three.
points.partial_credit: Only two of the three initial values (S, I, Q) named precisely: 0.25.

rubric.notes: Each of the four required details must be named precisely with the correct technical term (storage–elevation, inflow hydrograph, elevation–outflow, initial S, I, Q at t=0). Vague or generic answers such as "reservoir data" or "flood data" earn nothing for that point. A wrong extra item (e.g. rainfall intensity or evaporation as a required detail) cancels the point it most resembles. Half of a point is given only for P4 when two of the three initial values are named.
